A01M.fTerm:
CATCHING, TRAPPING OR SCARING OF ANIMALS (appliances for catching swarms or drone-catching A01K 57/00; fishing A01K 69/00-A01K 97/00; biocides, pest repellants or attractants A01N); APPARATUS FOR THE DESTRUCTION OF NOXIOUS ANIMALS OR NOXIOUS PLANTS

Note(s)

  • In this subclass, terms "killing" and "destruction" cover "non-chemical sterilisation" of invertebrates.[7]
